Episode 6 was just published to the [RSS feed](https://anchor.fm/s/10dbf5b7c/podcast/rss). Please add it to the website, using episodes 1-5 as examples (new `content/episodes/epNN.md`, guest page under `content/people/` with cross-links, and the cover saved to `quartz/static/covers/EPNN-cover.png`).

**Title:** Skills, Memory, Collaboration: What's Next for Al Agents with Zora Wang | AM Podcast #6
**Description:**

```
Zora Wang is a CS PhD student at Carnegie Mellon University. Zora’s work lies at the intersection of coding agents and human-ai collaboration.  In this episode we explore how agents work, how humans work, and how we can get more done together.

Outline:
0:00 - Introduction
4:57 - Agent Workflow Memory
9:26 - From Program Synthesis to Agent Research
11:16 - Tools, Actions, and Skills
18:47 - Human Work vs. Agent Work
21:19 - Autonomous Agents vs. Collaborative Agents
29:47 - Picking Research Problems in the Age of AI Agents
34:09 - The Role of Coding Ability in Agent Development
36:49 - Cutting Through the Fear Mongering: Building Agents Responsibly
45:02 - What’s Next? (The Future of Human-Agent Collaboration)
52:42 - Final Takeaway

References:
Zora’s Homepage: https://zorazrw.github.io/ 
Agent Workflow Memory: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.07429 
How Do AI Agents Do Human Work? Comparing AI and Human Workflows Across Diverse Occupations: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22780 

Podcast Links:
Podcast website: https://augmented-mind.github.io/
Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/augmented-mind-podcast/id1868102170
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/40KculkYTe2tOpqJm6TAYr?si=PU_UncsMT4mXjVNCRwoXog&nd=1&dlsi=6d9bed7a43d64085
RSS: https://anchor.fm/s/10dbf5b7c/podcast/rss

About the Hosts:
The AM Podcast is hosted by Yijia Shao, Shannon Shen, and Michael Ryan, CS PhD students at Stanford University and MIT.
```
